literature_notes: All six ledger lines (L1–L6) describe C-terminally HA-tagged full-length ATP10D expressed in HeLa cells or fibroblasts. The topology landmarks place the C-terminus (residue 1426) in the intracellular region (1318–1426), so the HA tag is on the cytoplasmic face and does not qualify as an extracellular surface tag site. The N-terminus (residues 1–97) is also intracellular. The five extracellular loops (EL1: 119–121, 3 aa; EL2: 343–369, 27 aa; EL3: 1135–1145, 11 aa; EL4: 1217–1225, 9 aa; EL5: 1277–1296, 20 aa) are not addressed by any ledger line. No ledger line supports any extracellular tag insertion for ATP10D; therefore zero sites are proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal HA tag (insert_after residue 1426, the last residue S) is in the intracellular region (1318–1426) per topology landmarks; confirmed functional in lipid-transport assays but faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
